puzzleText:
Kenny, a notorious cyber crook, gets caught hacking into the wrong system and is sentenced to jail on New Year's Day, 2025. But Kenny has a bigger problem than prison time—his three girlfriends must never find out about each other.

Each of his girlfriends makes a promise:

    Girlfriend A visits every 7 days (starting January 1, 2025).
    Girlfriend B visits every 5 days.
    Girlfriend C visits every 4 days.

Kenny is confident that he can keep them from meeting—unless all three of them visit on the same day. If that happens, the jig is up, and he’ll be dumped by all of them at once!

The Question:
On what date in 2025 will all three girlfriends visit him on the same day and expose his sneaky love triangle?
hint: To solve it, you need to find the least common multiple (LCM) of 7, 5, and 4.
title: Crooked Kenny's Love Dilemma
